frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015), 50.47″ = 1.06 kpc: 145 pc. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

bulge.basis: Old objects fill the bulge as well as the disc: each is a bulge member with the bulge's share of S4G's fitted light at its sky position (faded out between 1.6 and 3.21 kpc as the image layers' is), and then sits at a depth drawn from the bulge's density along its sight line. Membership is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Globular cluster candidates of M94 from González-Lópezlira et al. (2022), picked by their colors and shapes in CFHT images: one dot per candidate at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
